data.title: Captain D's Builds Momentum for International Growth as Franchise Interest Expands Across Europe
data.description: In Nashville, Tennessee on October 2, 2026, Captain D's, the top fast-casual seafood franchise in the U.S., is gaining traction for its global expansion efforts as it sees increased interest from potential franchise partners in Europe. This comes after a fruitful international development phase, signaling the company's aim to broaden its presence beyond national borders.

data.title: Rice Biotech Launch Pad invents 'living pharmacy' designed to produce therapeutics inside the body
data.description: In 2027, a long-lasting implant with diverse applications is set to be introduced in clinics, offering a novel therapeutic method that remains effective for a whole year. The implant's durability addresses the issue of accessibility often associated with biologic medications due to their high costs. This innovative approach signifies a breakthrough in the field of medicine. The announcement was made in Houston on October 2, 2026.

data.title: New interactive map of Costa Rica showcases its cultural, natural and ocean heritage
data.description: Costa Rica has launched "Discover Costa Rica," a no-cost platform created in collaboration with essential COSTA RICA, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Worship, CIMAR-UCR, and the UCR School of Geography. This initiative was established on Oct. 2, 2026, in San José. The platform serves as a virtual hub for information and resources about the country, facilitated by key partners.

data.title: Craftsman's Choice Moves Headquarters to Maple Grove, Plans New Exterior Remodeling Showroom
data.description: A Minnesota contractor specializing in exterior remodeling is set to unveil a new showroom in Maple Grove, Minnesota. The showroom will showcase top brands including James Hardie siding, Marvin windows and doors, GAF roofing, and TimberTech decking. The grand opening is scheduled ahead of the 2027 spring remodeling season. Craftsman's Choice Inc. made the announcement on October 2, 2026.

data.title: In HelloNation, Physical Therapy Expert Dr. J. Rashid Explains Why Prehab & Post-Surgical Rehab Are Both Critical for Full Recovery
data.description: In a recent HelloNation feature, Dr. J. Rashid, a Doctor of Physical Therapy and clinic director at Family Rehab Care in Taylor, Michigan, shared valuable insights. The clinic caters to patients in Taylor and surrounding areas. The article delves into the reasons behind the slow progress in recovery for individuals.

data.title: Tanner Winterhof's Farm4Profit Media Wins Inaugural MACA Industry Impact Award
data.description: A Midwest crop protection industry association recently presented its inaugural impact award to an independent podcast company that operates from a converted Casey's General Store in SLATER, Iowa. The award was given by the Mid America CropLife Association on October 2, 2026, marking a significant milestone for both the association and the podcast company. This recognition highlights the unique contributions and achievements of the podcast company within the industry, showcasing their innovation and impact.

data.title: Controller Malia M. Cohen Publishes 2025 Higher Education Payroll Data
data.description: In Sacramento, California on October 2, 2026, State Controller Malia M. Cohen released the self-reported payroll information for the year 2025 concerning University of California (UC) institutions and California Community College Districts (CCD). The data was published on the Government Compensation in California website.

data.title: dōTERRA "Imagine" Global Convention Inspires Thousands in Orlando and Unveils Bold New Wellness Innovations
data.description: dōTERRA's 2026 Global Convention, themed "Imagine," drew a record-breaking crowd of over 10,000 participants, who attended either in person or virtually. The event, held from September 23 to 26 in Orlando, Florida, was significant as it marked the first instance in the company's history where the annual convention was hosted outside its usual location.

data.title: Winter Fest OC Announces All-New Holiday Light Trail & Attraction Add-Ons Now Available
data.description: This year's Winter Fest OC, taking place at the OC Fair and Event Center in Costa Mesa, California starting on November 27, promises to deliver a plethora of immersive spectacles and countless photo opportunities for visitors. As Southern California's most extensive winter festival, it aims to captivate attendees with its upgraded attractions and engaging experiences. This festive event is anticipated to draw a significant crowd, offering a space where individuals can enjoy the holiday season to the fullest.

data.title: equipifi® Named a "Best Places to Work in the Valley" Finalist After a Year of Rapid Growth
data.description: Scottsdale, Arizona-based equipifi has experienced rapid growth after securing funding in a recent Series B raise. The company, a top provider of bank-led Buy Now, Pay Later (BNPL) solutions, has been recognized as a finalist in the Phoenix area. This recognition comes amid their significant expansion, indicating a positive trajectory for the company. The nomination underlines equipifi's increasing prominence in the industry and underscores its potential impact.

data.title: University of Phoenix leaders to present on scaling competency-based education at CBExchange 2026
data.description: Two leading figures, Marc Booker and Justin Hallock, will be sharing insights on their experience in producing over 5,000 competency-based education graduates over six years. The announcement was made in Phoenix on October 2, 2026. Marc Booker, serving as the vice provost of Strategy, and Justin Hallock, a senior within the organization, will be discussing their success at the University of Phoenix.

data.title: KBRA Assigns AA Rating, Stable Outlook to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, NY Transportation Revenue Refunding Green Bonds, Series 2026A (Climate Bond Certified)
data.description: In New York, credit rating agency KBRA has assigned a long-term rating of AA to the Metropolitan Transportation Authority's NY Transportation Revenue Refunding Green Bonds, Series 2026A (Climate Bond Certified). Additionally, they have affirmed the long-term rating of AA on outstanding Transportation Revenue Bonds, with a Stable Outlook. The rating actions are based on key credit considerations, including the strong coverage of annual debt service provided by the gross revenue pledge.

data.title: LSTA, Inc. Welcomes SEC Proposal Clarifying Treatment of Discretionary Trading Authority Under Custody Rule
data.description: LSTA, Inc. expressed appreciation for the Securities and Exchange Commission's proposed amendments to the investment adviser custody rule. The organization particularly welcomed the exception for authorized discretionary trading activity. This move is seen as a positive step in addressing industry uncertainties. The proposed amendments aim to provide clarity and common-sense solutions to longstanding issues. LSTA, Inc. views this proposal as significant progress in resolving key matters within the industry.
